nodes.description: Owner address stored in BotProtected; set to tx.origin in BackedToken constructor and used as the only privileged account.
External bot-protection contract address invoked through low-level calls from the checkBots modifier and list().
Uniswap/Pancake pair address computed in the constructor via pairForPancake and passed to the bot protection call.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and list.
Public nested mapping of spending allowances, written in approve and in the constructor for the router and tx.origin.
Total token supply (100000000000000000000000000), also read in list to compute the owner allocation.
IUniswapV2Router02 instance used by list() to add liquidity.
Wrapped ETH address used as one side of the pair computation.
Constant token decimals (18).
Token name 'BACKED'.
Token symbol 'BAKT'.
Initializes botProtection from the constructor argument.
Modifier that performs a low-level call to botProtection before executing the modified function body.
Sets owner to tx.origin, computes the pair, and grants infinite allowances to the router and to tx.origin.
Payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Payable transferFrom guarded by checkBots; performs unchecked allowance and balance updates.
Payable approve that directly overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only function that performs an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-controlled address a with calldata b.
Pure function deriving the deterministic pair address from two tokens via keccak256.
Owner-only listing function that writes balances, adds liquidity and calls botProtection with an arbitrary target array.
Checked addition helper from the SafeMath library.
Checked subtraction helpers from the SafeMath library.
Checked multiplication helper from the SafeMath library.
Checked division helpers from the SafeMath library.
Internal ERC20 balance transfer using SafeMath (abstract contract, not used by BackedToken).
Internal ERC20 mint helper using SafeMath (abstract contract, not used by BackedToken).
Internal ERC20 burn helper using SafeMath (abstract contract, not used by BackedToken).
Internal ERC20 allowance writer with zero-address checks.
Caller-controlled address read in transfer, transferFrom, approve, delegate and list.
Transaction origin used to set owner and to self-grant an unlimited allowance in the constructor.
Used in list to build the addLiquidityETH deadline (block.timestamp + 600).
a.delegatecall(b): arbitrary delegatecall giving full control over contract storage to address a.
botProtection.call(...) inside the modifier: external call executed before the transferFrom body, whose return value only gates execution.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath (Solidity ^0.7 has no checked arithmetic).
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath.
totalSupply * 6 / 100 performed without SafeMath when crediting the owner in list.
botProtection.call(0xd5eaf4c3, _reallyGoHere): arbitrary external call with attacker/owner supplied array.
pancakeRouter.addLiquidityETH{value: msg.value}(...) external value call with user-supplied amounts and timestamp-based deadline.
Constructor argument _botProtection of BotProtected.
Constructor argument _botProtection of BackedToken, forwarded to BotProtected.
_from parameter of transferFrom / checkBots.
_to parameter of transferFrom / checkBots.
_value parameter of transferFrom / checkBots, drives all unchecked balance math.
_numList parameter of list, used as liquidity token amount and contract balance.
_reallyGoHere address array of list, used as bot-protection calldata and as balance recipients.
_amounts array of list, assigned directly into balanceOf.
Address a, delegatecall target in delegate.
Bytes b, delegatecall payload in delegate.
Loop index i iterating over _reallyGoHere in list.
tokenA parameter of pairForPancake.
tokenB parameter of pairForPancake.
Lower-ordered token local used in the keccak256 pair derivation.
Higher-ordered token local used in the keccak256 pair derivation.

edges.reason: Constructor argument _botProtection flows into the BotProtected constructor.
BackedToken constructor argument is forwarded to the BotProtected base constructor.
owner is set to tx.origin, so any phishing/relayed transaction becomes the privileged owner.
allowance[tx.origin][uniPair] is set to uint(-1) using tx.origin in the constructor.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from account to transferFrom.
transferFrom reads msg.sender to compare with _from and to decrement the caller allowance.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender], caller-controlled.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping that is decremented without checks.
_from indexes allowance[_from][msg.sender] which is decremented with unchecked arithmetic.
_value is subtracted from the allowance without SafeMath.
_from indexes balanceOf[_from], decremented with unchecked arithmetic.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
_to indexes balanceOf[_to], incremented with unchecked arithmetic.
_value is added to balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath, allowing supply inflation.
totalSupply participates in totalSupply * 6 / 100 computed with unchecked arithmetic.
msg.sender receives the totalSupply * 6 / 100 allocation in list.
The unchecked allocation result is written into balanceOf[msg.sender].
_numList is passed as the liquidity token amount to the router.
pancakeRouter is the target of the external addLiquidityETH call.
msg.sender is passed as the LP recipient 'to' argument.
block.timestamp + 600 is used as the swap deadline, making it timestamp dependent.
_reallyGoHere is ABI-encoded into the low-level botProtection call.
botProtection is the target of the arbitrary low-level call in list.
Loop recipients from _reallyGoHere are written into balanceOf.
_amounts values are assigned directly into balanceOf without checks.
Address a becomes the delegatecall target, letting the owner run arbitrary code on this storage.
Bytes b becomes the delegatecall payload.
tokenA is ordered into token0 for the pair hash.
tokenB is ordered into token0 for the pair hash.
tokenA is ordered into token1 for the pair hash.
tokenB is ordered into token1 for the pair hash.
pairForPancake result is assigned to uniPair in the constructor.
Loop index i indexes _reallyGoHere during the distribution loop.
_from is passed to the checkBots bot-protection call.
_to is passed to the checkBots bot-protection call.
_value is passed to the checkBots bot-protection call.
botProtection is the target of the low-level call inside the modifier.
Constructor computes and stores uniPair.
Constructor writes infinite allowances for the router and tx.origin.
ERC20._transfer mutates balance balances.
ERC20._approve writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom reads balanceOf[_from] for its solvency require.
transferFrom reads allowance[_from][msg.sender] for its approval require.
checkBots modifier wraps transferFrom, receiving its arguments.
The unchecked external botProtection.call in the modifier executes before the transferFrom state updates, enabling reentrancy into transfer/transferFrom.
delegate unconditionally invokes a.delegatecall(b) after the owner check.
The delegatecall target can re-enter the contract (including delegate) with full storage control.
list invokes the low-level botProtection call before the distribution loop.
list invokes addLiquidityETH before writing balances.
list uses the loop index i to iterate the distribution.
require(msg.sender == owner) guards delegate.
require(msg.sender == owner) guards list.
The external botProtection call can re-enter list before balances/emissions are finalized.
addLiquidityETH is an external call that may re-enter the token before the balance writes in list.
list builds its deadline from block.timestamp, coupling execution to miner-controlled time.

normalization_plan.reason: _botProtection constructor parameter only feeds the BotProtected constructor and should be folded into it.
BackedToken constructor parameter _botProtection is a transient value forwarded to the base constructor and belongs to the constructor node.
Parameter _from is only meaningful inside transferFrom (and its modifier) and should be absorbed there.
Parameter _to is only meaningful inside transferFrom and should be absorbed there.
Parameter _value drives the unchecked balance math in transferFrom and should be absorbed there.
Parameter _numList is only used as the liquidity amount inside list.
Parameter _reallyGoHere is only used inside list as calldata and as recipients.
Parameter _amounts is only used inside list to fill balances.
Parameter a is only the delegatecall target inside delegate.
Parameter b is only the delegatecall payload inside delegate.
Loop variable i exists solely to iterate in list.
Parameter tokenA is only consumed by pairForPancake.
Parameter tokenB is only consumed by pairForPancake.
Local token0 is only produced inside pairForPancake for the pair hash.
Local token1 is only produced inside pairForPancake for the pair hash.
